up: Retrieve the exact activity values and chemical structures for all compounds tested in the assay with ChEMBL ID 'CHEMBL4513218'. Return the molecule ChEMBL ID, standard value, standard units, standard relation, and canonical SMILES. Filter activities to only include exact measurements where standard_relation equals '='. sql: SELECT DISTINCT md.chembl_id, a.standard_value, a.standard_units, a.standard_relation, cs.canonical_smiles FROM assays ass JOIN activities a ON ass.assay_id = a.assay_id JOIN molecule_dictionary md ON a.molregno = md.molregno LEFT JOIN compound_structures cs ON a.molregno = cs.molregno WHERE ass.chembl_id = 'CHEMBL4513218' AND a.standard_relation = '='
